subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - EnterpriseBank
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@enterprisebank.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@enterprisebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 19:02:00 +0000
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - EnterpriseBank

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Per the demo, I wanted to summarize what we covered and propose a 6-week POC plan to validate Redwood for your in-product assistant use case. I’ve attached a short POC proposal and the demo recording.

Quick recap from our call:
- Primary use case: in-product help + contextual responses from transaction and user profile data.
- Success signals you called out: answer accuracy >= 85% on representative prompts, mean latency < 250ms for 95th percentile, no PII leakage, and ability to run in your VPC for regulated data.
- Key stakeholders: Alex (POC sponsor), Priya (Security), Richard (Platform), Marissa (SE - technical lead).

Proposed 6-week POC (high level):
1) Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, access & environment setup (VPC, test dataset, API keys).
2) Weeks 1-2: Integration + baseline runs. Provide sample prompts and baseline metrics with your dev team.
3) Weeks 3-4: Iterate on prompt engineering, caching and batching config, quantization profile for cost targets.
4) Week 5: Evaluate against success criteria and run 1-week production-like load test.
5) Week 6: Final results review, runbook & next steps (Dedicated/private deployment discussions).

Ownership: Redwood SE (Marissa) will lead technical integration and tuning; I’ll own project coordination and success criteria. From your side, Richard can provide VPC/network contacts and a small dev resource to integrate the SDK.

Deliverables we’ll send you by EOD Monday:
- POC proposal PDF (attached)
- Test prompt set / evaluation harness
- Temporary test credentials + example integration snippet

Can you confirm: 1) OK to proceed with the above timeline, 2) who will be the dev owner on your side, and 3) any mandatory security checks we should pre-share (e.g., IP allowlist, specific certs)?

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0132 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: 20260320-enterprisebank-poc-proposal.pdf, demo-recording-20260319.mp4
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@enterprisebank.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@enterprisebank.com>, Richard Lee <rlee@enterprisebank.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - EnterpriseBank

Dylan — thanks for the summary and materials. The plan looks reasonable. A couple notes from our side after internal sync: 

Success criteria tweaks:
- Accuracy target: prefer >= 88% for top-1 correctness on our 200-sample test set (we'll share the set).
- Latency: 95th percentile target <= 250ms is fine but we also want median < 100ms for interactive flows.
- Cost sensitivity: target to be < $0.005 per 1k tokens for the POC (ballpark) — we'll use that to decide on quantization settings.

Security & environment:
- Priya will lead the security review. For the kickoff we need your SOC2 summary and the short security-evidence-summary (if you have a one-pager). Please also confirm you support AWS PrivateLink and customer-managed KMS for the POC.
- Richard: we'll create a test VPC and can provide a temporary NAT + peering setup. He'll reach out with network details.

Resources / timeline:
- Dev owner: Sam Patel (sam.patel@enterprisebank.com) will be the main integration lead — copying him on this thread (cc'ed).
- Can we push the full integration window to Weeks 1-3 (extra time to wire our test data anonymization pipeline)? If so, we'd shift the later evaluation by 2 weeks; still aiming for a ~6-8 week total window.

Next items from us:
1) I’ll share the 200-sample test prompts and expected answers by Monday.
2) Priya will review the security one-pager and get back with any blockers.
3) Sam will coordinate a time for the kickoff next week.

Thanks — keen to run this.

Alex — perfect, thanks for the clarity. Short answers below and next steps: 

- Accuracy: we’ll aim for >= 88% top-1 on your 200-sample set. Please share the set and ground truth (S3 link or Drive).
- Latency & cost: Marissa will propose a quantization and batching plan to meet your latency/cost targets; she’ll include a recommended inference config and expected per-token cost estimates.
- Security: yes, we support AWS PrivateLink and customer-managed KMS for keys. I’ve attached the SOC2/summary and a short security-evidence-summary.
- Timeline: moving integration out to Weeks 1-3 is fine — we’ll update the POC doc accordingly and aim for a 7-week window.

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Mar 24 — 10:00 AM ET (30-45 min). If that works, Sam and Priya, please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Action items I’ll take this week:
- Updated POC PDF with shifted timeline (attached).
- Provide temporary test credentials and example SDK snippet for Sam.
- Marissa to prepare initial inference config and prompts to test.

If Sam can confirm kickoff availability, we’ll lock it in.

Thanks,
Dylan

Thanks everyone — excited to kick this off.
